Leah Collins: FYI candidate Avery Brooks (Phoenix, MST) asked for Saturday AM interview due to weekday commitments. Avery is Deaf and requests an ASL interpreter + live captions. Also prefers a written-only feedback option (no audio). Can we accommodate Saturday 09:00-12:00 MST?
Omar Vega: I can do 09:00-10:00 for system design on Saturday.
Priya Nair: I can cover coding 10:15-11:45 but prefer take-home + live review rather than live proctoring. Does accessibility policy allow take-home for coding?
AccessLive-bot: Vendor check: ASL interpreter available via AccessLive with 24h notice for Saturday mornings. Rate applies. We can request interpreter for 09:00-12:00 MST. Live captions on Zoom enabled; confirm transcript delivery (SRT) required?
Leah Collins: Yes please request SRT transcript and include a written feedback workflow. Candidate asked that interviews be text-friendly: panelers to use chat for clarifying questions and avoid uncaptioned audio.
SecurityOps: Note: if candidate requests NDA or private portfolio review, do not record video; transcript only with candidate consent. If loaner hardware issued, LOA required.
Priya Nair: For coding: offer take-home exercise (48h) and schedule a 30-min review on Saturday 10:15 where candidate can paste solution into a shared doc. That respects accessibility and avoids realtime proctoring. Panel ok with that?
Omar Vega: Fine with take-home + live review. We'll keep the review to 30min and focus on reasoning, not running tests.
Leah Collins: Booking notes: ASL interpreter + captions, SRT transcript delivery, calendar invite with detailed written agenda, and a 15-min quiet buffer after each session so Avery can rest. Also include accommodation contact.
AccessLive-bot: ASL interpreter booked (Booking ID AL-9921) for Sat 08:50-12:15 MST. Invoice to hiring-squad. SRT transcript delivery confirmed.
recruiter-bot: Draft calendar event: https://calendar.redwood.ai/events/1891234000  invites pending. Include: take-home instructions link, ASL interpreter note, captions enabled, SRT transcript, written-feedback request, and 15-min buffers.
Priya Nair: I'll send take-home prompt immediately and schedule the 30-min review slot. Also will add a short checklist for panelers reminding them to use chat and captions.
SecurityOps: Confirmed: no recording of video. Transcripts SRT stored in secure bucket with restricted access, retention 90 days.
Leah Collins: Candidate message excerpt: "Thanks Avery  we can do Saturday 09:00-12:00 MST with ASL interpreter and captions. We'll send the take-home coding prompt now; review slot at 10:15. Please confirm and tell us if you want the SRT transcript after. Also, we will not record video without consent."
recruiter-bot: Reminder scheduled: send candidate checklist 24h before interview and interpreter hello 30min before start.
Omar Vega: :thumbsup: all good from my side.
Priya Nair: Adding panel checklist now. Thanks team.
Leah Collins: Closing thread  accommodations confirmed.
